observations.behavior: Adds a per-form probe configuration and its use in credential validation, replacing a hardcoded submissions-only probe.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows credential checks against the metadata endpoint, not just submissions, supporting broader API access validation.

observations.behavior: Updates credential validation to use the selected probe and report errors per probe, not just submissions.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes credential checks and error reporting generic across metadata and submissions, not submissions-only.

observations.behavior: Adds parameterized unit tests and removes the previous non-parameterized version, changing the test name and its assertions to use supplied expected values.
observations.posthog_connection: These assertions check the warehouse ingestion configuration for the Fillout connector, specifically the partition mode and keys used when loading form submission data. This could help prevent runtime failures or incorrect partitioning if the connector implementation changes, but without changes to the actual ingestion or shared dependency, this is not evidence of a broader benefit
